cases.title: cached native grant
checks: No new dispatch under revoked authority

cases.title: rule revocation
checks: Current revision is checked at enforcement boundary

cases.title: policy epoch
checks: Stale permit cannot authorize dispatch

cases.title: final arguments
checks: Changed final arguments require fresh binding

cases.title: final cwd
checks: Changed cwd invalidates prior binding

cases.title: final resources
checks: Changed resources invalidate prior binding

cases.title: hook missing
checks: Unsupported state with no strict dispatch

cases.title: hook tamper
checks: Detect drift and stop further strict dispatch

cases.title: policy outage
checks: No permissive fallback for strict enforcement

cases.title: unknown version
trace: peer claims unsupported evidence or hook version
checks: No capability inferred from self-reported label

cases.title: identical concurrent
trace: two identical actions with distinct callbacks race
checks: One permit never authorizes both actions

cases.title: same item new callback
checks: Old answer cannot bind new callback

cases.title: duplicate answer
checks: At most one accepted recording and original callback delivery

cases.title: cancel before dispatch
trace: cancel while authority or persistence awaits
checks: No subsequent positive delivery or new dispatch

cases.title: cancel after dispatch
checks: Preserve dispatch and unknown effect; no rollback claim

cases.title: expiry
trace: clock reaches original expiry during await
checks: No expiry extension or late dispatch

cases.title: owner death
trace: owner dies after review before delivery
checks: Original live callback expires; no transfer

cases.title: restart
trace: restart with copied durable approval history
checks: No replay of dead live callback

cases.title: lease loss
trace: original execution lease replaced during await
checks: Refuse under original ownership fence

cases.title: uncertain record
trace: append may commit but acknowledgement fails
checks: Do not retry decision or non-idempotent action

cases.title: lost delivery ack
checks: Inspect original state; delivery unknown until proved

cases.title: checker outage
trace: required checker times out or disconnects
checks: No silent allow or unbounded pending work

cases.title: malformed checker
trace: checker returns invalid or oversized frame
checks: Bounded failure without dispatch

cases.title: authority race
trace: revoke responder or execution principal during await
checks: Current resource authority rechecked inside fence

cases.title: unknown scope
trace: missing scope descriptor or stripped field
checks: Missing is unknown; not authoritative absence

cases.title: unsafe disclosure
trace: necessary command/path cannot be safely disclosed
checks: Unavailable with no positive choice

cases.title: changed offer
trace: native offered decision mapping changes after review
checks: No choice inferred from label or stale mapping

cases.title: broader grant
trace: allow_once label maps to turn/session/profile grant
checks: No exact-command authority from broader grant

cases.title: framing budget
trace: multibyte JSON reaches row and enclosing result limit
checks: Include framing; no truncation advertised as exact

cases.title: forged metadata
trace: agent supplies plausible evidence in rawInput or metadata
checks: No provenance inferred from payload shape

cases.title: protected projection
trace: private synthetic canaries in raw context and environment
checks: No forbidden field in public UI/audit/error/replay/log

cases.title: unknown effect
trace: effect observed while callback delivery unknown
checks: Preserve effect; never invent allow or delivery

cases.title: unexpected effect
checks: Fail even if no successful approval exists

cases.title: native filesystem
trace: agent uses native fs without ACP callback
checks: Excluded or unknown unless independent enforcement proved

cases.title: native shell
trace: native cached shell action has no ask
checks: Observe actual dispatch; absent telemetry leaves blocking and execution unknown

cases.title: interactive stdin
checks: Separate action/scope; no inherited exact-command claim

cases.title: descendant
trace: approved parent launches child or subagent
checks: Containment requires independent descendant evidence

cases.title: alternate mcp
checks: No mediation claim from primary route alone

cases.title: client filesystem
trace: client fs callback uses symlink/path swap
checks: Physical effect confinement is separate from lexical match

cases.title: client terminal
checks: Unsupported; no inferred terminal executor

cases.title: remote custom
trace: custom session or remote host bypasses local hook
checks: Coverage remains unsupported or unknown until separately qualified; a local sandbox cannot establish remote confinement or absence of remote effects

cases.title: disabled
checks: No judge invocation or disclosure

cases.title: advisory
trace: judge recommends allow while deterministic policy denies
checks: Advice never overrides authority ceiling

cases.title: required timeout
checks: Required remains required; no optional fallback

cases.title: malformed
trace: judge returns unknown fields, malformed JSON or oversized reply
checks: Reject boundedly; no executable instructions

cases.title: contradictory
trace: judge returns inconsistent verdict and rationale
checks: No positive authority from contradictory output

cases.title: prompt injection
trace: command content instructs judge to ignore policy
checks: Untrusted text cannot change mode, routing or policy

cases.title: replacement
trace: swap two synthetic judge implementations on same input
checks: Deterministic composition/ceilings unchanged; identity revision tracked

cases.title: model config change
checks: Invalidate stale advice according to reviewed binding

cases.title: cross provider
trace: judge destination differs from approved projection destination
checks: No automatic disclosure to replacement provider

cases.title: credential exclusion
trace: synthetic credential and environment canaries in source context
checks: Judge input excludes credentials/raw context/private digests

cases.title: failure privacy
checks: Safe errors/logging; no raw reply retained publicly
